style: Test Site House (vault) + notes/house_1965_style.md: 1965 desert test town, dusty, warm, hazy
units: 1 Blender unit = 1 stud, Z up, plan coordinates as art/house/v2 (x east, y north, z up; exterior ground plane z = -1, house floor z = 0; house walls x -40..40, y -30..30; front door x 0..6 on y -30, back door x -6..0 on y 30)
rules: art only (no collision); max 2,000 studs on any axis per MeshPart (Roblox limit)
own textures only, 1024 atlases, worn and dusty like the 1965 exterior; reuse art/house/v2 exterior atlases where they fit
FBX in centimetres like v2 (Studio import at scale 0.01), pivots as v2

pieces.name: X_PorchFront
pieces.view: 5-40 studs, from MB_S / FY_S looking down
pieces.notes: outside y -36..-30 at x -3..9: concrete stoop z -1..0 with 2 steps down to the path, two slim white posts, a small flat canopy at z 10.5-11.5 over the door; must stay below z 13.5 (FY_S window x -3..7 z 14-24.5 above it) and clear of x 0..6 y -30.5..-30

pieces.name: X_BackStoop
pieces.notes: outside y 30..35 at x -7..1: concrete stoop z -1..0, 2 steps, iron handrail, doormat, a milk crate

pieces.name: X_Driveway
pieces.notes: cracked concrete slab x 16..30 y -56..-31 at z -0.95 with oil stains and tyre marks; plus a 1.5-wide gravel / soil strip round the house foot (outside x -40..40, y -30..30) so the fieldstone base meets dirt

pieces.name: X_TownHouse_A
pieces.notes: <=600 tris, one storey, low gable, 4 colourways in one atlas (butter, salmon, mint, white), dark window squares, fieldstone base band

pieces.name: X_WaterTower
pieces.notes: <=1,500 tris, steel legs + cross bracing, tank with our own stencil 'T-7' or none

pieces.name: X_Bunker
pieces.notes: <=400 tris, slit window, blast door, sandbag ring

pieces.name: X_Quonset
pieces.notes: <=800 tris, half-cylinder, end wall with doors

pieces.name: X_ObservationStand
pieces.kind: mid: timber stand with shade roof

pieces.name: X_ChainLink
pieces.kind: mid: chain-link fence run with posts

pieces.name: X_PoleLine
pieces.kind: mid: 8 power poles 60 apart + sagging wires

pieces.name: X_GroundSkirt
pieces.notes: 12 segments (< 2,000 on any axis), z -1.05 at the inner edge (just under the v2 1800-square ground) falling gently to z -6 at the outer edge; long low dunes, dirt tracks, scrub dots in the texture near the inner edge; colour fades to haze (214,196,166) at the outer edge; <=1,500 tris total

pieces.name: X_MesaRing
pieces.size: tier 1 radius 1,100-1,400 height 60-180 (mesas, buttes, warm tan-rust (176,132,96)); tier 2 radius 1,800-2,200 height 150-320 (ridges, (196,170,140)); tier 3 radius 2,800-3,400 height 250-520 (range, close to haze (210,194,168))
pieces.notes: faces toward the centre (backfaces may be culled), bases sunk 10+ under the skirt, no straight top edge, no two matching silhouettes in any 90-degree view, gaps in tier 1 show tier 2 / 3 behind so no sky shows below a ridge anywhere round the full 360; each tier 8-12 segments (< 2,000 on any axis); <=5,000 tris total

deliver: art/house/illusion/: house_illusion.blend; fbx/X_Near.fbx (porch, stoop, driveway, strip in plan place), fbx/X_Mid.fbx (one of each mid piece at the origin + K_ScaleCube), fbx/X_Far.fbx (skirt + ring in plan place + K_ScaleCube); tex/; manifest house_illusion.json (each piece: size, tris, materials, atlas); preview renders; DONE.md
